newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end lower, recovery seen Monday.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end lower, recovery seen Monday.

text.p: Portuguese shares ignored gains on other European bourses to close lower as instability on Wall Street and the prospect of a rise in U.S. short-term rates undermined prices. Dealers said shares could recover some ground on Monday.
*PSI20 index .PSI20 lost 34.80 points to end at 5,932.10 with volume of 4.9 billion escudos.
*"Things could pick up on Monday since Europe seems buoyant and we've seen a lot of losses here, but it depends on how New York closes."
*PSI20 April futures were off 33 points at 5,805.
*Portugal Telecom fell 79 esc to 6,000 with 252,588 shares traded.
*Portucel Industrial bucked the trend and added 14 esc to 1,079 on volume of 134,399.
*Inparsa lost 25 esc to 1,405 with turnover of 129,780.
